verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cekura offers CLI/SDK/API access to agents, scenarios, runs, and call data (cekura-docs-4, cekura-docs-5), plus a send-calls API, but there is no mention of bulk export to blob storage (S3/GCS) or data warehouse sinks (BigQuery/Snowflake), nor a documented export/sync feature for traces and datasets in bulk. missing for 10: bulk export endpoint or job, blob storage integration (S3/GCS/Azure Blob), data warehouse connectors (BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift), any documentation of export formats or scheduled export pipelines.
